# VR-2: MeA–BST GABAergic Program Identity

## Overview

`0338 MEA-BST Sox6 Gaba_2` carries the largest-magnitude D-SPIN response in the study, but `Lhx6`/`Sox6` label both local interneurons and extended-amygdala projection neurons. This notebook asks whether `0338` P10, `0355` P5, and `0359` P6 are one coordinated program, what lineage they resemble, whether they bridge to the MAST catalogue, and where they sit spatially relative to MeA, the stria terminalis, and BST.

## Background

The disinhibition model means different things for local interneurons (intra-MeA) versus MeA→BST projection neurons (BST target). Shared gene membership, projection-marker enrichment, and MeA-to-BST spatial spread would support the figure as drawn; interneuron markers with MeA-confined somata would require redrawing the GABA limb inside MeA.

::: {.takeaways}
**Key takeaways**

- MeA-confined somata are compatible with either identity; MeA **and** BST along the stria supports the projection-neuron reading.
- If panel coverage of program genes is ≲20%, treat spatial scores as qualitative only.
- Report the Allen / MapMyCells reference used — spatial labels may differ from snRNA.
:::

```{r}
#| label: cell-tbl-overlap
#| eval: !expr run_analysis

gaba <- gaba_output_programs()
read_prog <- function(label, pid) {
  f <- file.path(paths$dspin, paste0("AMY__", label), "programs_genes.csv")
  read_csv(f, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    filter(program_id == pid) %>%
    mutate(gene = strip_grcm39(gene)) %>%
    filter(!gene %in% VR_EXCLUDED_GENES) %>%
    pull(gene) %>%
    unique()
}

sets <- list(
  `0338_P10` = read_prog("CS20230722_SUPT_0338", "P10"),
  `0355_P5`  = read_prog("CS20230722_SUPT_0355", "P5"),
  `0359_P6`  = read_prog("CS20230722_SUPT_0359", "P6")
)
keys <- names(sets)
jac <- matrix(NA_real_, 3, 3, dimnames = list(keys, keys))
for (i in 1:3) for (j in 1:3) jac[i, j] <- jaccard(sets[[i]], sets[[j]])

three_way <- Reduce(intersect, sets)
union_all <- Reduce(union, sets)

# Null: draw matched-size sets from union of all programs in these three units
pool <- unique(unlist(lapply(gaba$supertype_label, function(lab) {
  f <- file.path(paths$dspin, paste0("AMY__", lab), "programs_genes.csv")
  strip_grcm39(read_csv(f, show_col_types = FALSE)$gene)
})))
pool <- setdiff(pool, VR_EXCLUDED_GENES)
set.seed(1)
n_draw <- 1000L
null_j <- replicate(n_draw, {
  a <- sample(pool, length(sets[[1]]))
  b <- sample(pool, length(sets[[2]]))
  c <- sample(pool, length(sets[[3]]))
  c(j12 = jaccard(a, b), j13 = jaccard(a, c), j23 = jaccard(b, c))
})

lines <- c(
  "# VR-2 program overlap",
  "",
  "## Gene-set sizes",
  sprintf("- 0338 P10: %d genes", length(sets[[1]])),
  sprintf("- 0355 P5: %d genes", length(sets[[2]])),
  sprintf("- 0359 P6: %d genes", length(sets[[3]])),
  sprintf("- Three-way intersection (n=%d): %s",
          length(three_way), paste(three_way, collapse = ", ")),
  "",
  "## Jaccard matrix",
  "",
  "```",
  paste(capture.output(print(round(jac, 3))), collapse = "\n"),
  "```",
  "",
  "## Null (1,000 draws from union of programs in these supertypes)",
  sprintf("- Observed J(0338,0355)=%.3f; null mean=%.3f (2.5–97.5%%: %.3f–%.3f)",
          jac[1, 2], mean(null_j["j12", ]),
          quantile(null_j["j12", ], 0.025), quantile(null_j["j12", ], 0.975)),
  sprintf("- Observed J(0338,0359)=%.3f; null mean=%.3f",
          jac[1, 3], mean(null_j["j13", ])),
  sprintf("- Observed J(0355,0359)=%.3f; null mean=%.3f",
          jac[2, 3], mean(null_j["j23", ])),
  ""
)
write_md(overlap_md, lines)
write_csv(as.data.frame(jac) %>% tibble::rownames_to_column("program"),
          file.path(tbl_dir, "VR2_jaccard.csv"))
```

```{r}
#| label: cell-tbl-identity
#| eval: !expr run_analysis

interneuron <- c("Pvalb", "Sst", "Vip", "Npy", "Lamp5", "Htr3a", "Reln", "Cnr1", "Calb2")
projection <- c("Foxp2", "Bcl11b", "Isl1", "Six3", "Pdyn", "Tac1", "Penk", "Nts", "Cartpt")
# Do NOT use Lhx6 or Sox6

score_markers <- function(label, panel, name) {
  df <- score_unit_via_python(label, panel, character(), paths = paths)
  if (is.null(df)) return(NULL)
  df %>%
    mutate(
      score = score_pos_only,
      panel = name,
      genes_used = length(panel)
    )
}

id_long <- bind_rows(
  lapply(gaba$supertype_label, score_markers, panel = interneuron, name = "interneuron"),
  lapply(gaba$supertype_label, score_markers, panel = projection, name = "projection")
)

identity <- id_long %>%
  group_by(supertype_label, animal, group, panel) %>%
  summarise(mean_score = mean(score, na.rm = TRUE), n_cells = n(),
            genes_used = first(genes_used), .groups = "drop") %>%
  pivot_wider(names_from = panel, values_from = c(mean_score, n_cells, genes_used))

write_csv(identity, identity_csv)
```

```{r}
#| label: cell-tbl-enrich
#| eval: !expr run_analysis

union_genes <- unique(unlist(sets))
cats <- list(
  gaba_identity = c("Gad1", "Gad2", "Slc32a1"),
  gaba_a_receptor = grep("^Gabra|^Gabrb|^Gabrg|^Gabrr|^Gabre|^Gabrd",
                         pool, value = TRUE),
  synaptic_organisers = unique(c(
    grep("^Nlgn|^Nrxn|^Cntn|^Lrrtm", pool, value = TRUE)
  )),
  neuropeptides = intersect(c("Pdyn", "Tac1", "Penk", "Nts", "Cartpt", "Npy",
                              "Sst", "Vip", "Crh", "Avp", "Oxt"), pool),
  axon_guidance = unique(c(
    grep("^Sema|^Robo|^Epha|^Ephb|^Dcc", pool, value = TRUE)
  ))
)

# Background: genes expressed in these units at matched detection (use pool)
# Hypergeometric vs matched-detection background = pool (already restricted)
enrich_rows <- lapply(names(cats), function(nm) {
  cat_genes <- intersect(cats[[nm]], pool)
  k <- length(intersect(union_genes, cat_genes))
  n <- length(union_genes)
  K <- length(cat_genes)
  N <- length(pool)
  p <- if (K == 0) NA_real_ else phyper(k - 1, K, N - K, n, lower.tail = FALSE)
  tibble(
    category = nm,
    n_in_union = k,
    category_size = K,
    union_size = n,
    background_size = N,
    background = "genes in any program of 0338/0355/0359 units (detection-restricted to program universe)",
    hypergeom_p = p,
    enrichment = (k / max(n, 1)) / max(K / max(N, 1), .Machine$double.eps)
  )
})
enrich <- bind_rows(enrich_rows)
write_csv(enrich, enrich_csv)
```

```{r}
#| label: cell-tbl-bridge
#| eval: !expr run_analysis

mast27 <- load_mast_hits(paths = paths) %>%
  filter(tissue == "AMY", !excluded_gene) %>%
  distinct(gene) %>%
  pull(gene)

# Focus list from spec + full AMY catalogue intersection
focus <- unique(c("Hap1", "Cntn6", "Itpkb", "Eps8l1", mast27))
bridge <- lapply(names(sets), function(nm) {
  tibble(
    program = nm,
    gene = focus,
    in_program = focus %in% sets[[nm]]
  )
}) %>% bind_rows()

# loadings if weight present
load_w <- function(label, pid) {
  f <- file.path(paths$dspin, paste0("AMY__", label), "programs_genes.csv")
  read_csv(f, show_col_types = FALSE) %>%
    filter(program_id == pid) %>%
    mutate(gene = strip_grcm39(gene), program = paste0(substr(label, 18, 21), "_", pid))
}
w_all <- bind_rows(
  load_w("CS20230722_SUPT_0338", "P10"),
  load_w("CS20230722_SUPT_0355", "P5"),
  load_w("CS20230722_SUPT_0359", "P6")
)
bridge2 <- bridge %>%
  left_join(w_all %>% select(gene, program_id, weight) %>%
              mutate(program = case_when(
                program_id == "P10" ~ "0338_P10",
                program_id == "P5" ~ "0355_P5",
                program_id == "P6" ~ "0359_P6"
              )), by = c("gene", "program"))

hits_bridge <- bridge2 %>% filter(in_program)
lines <- c(
  "# VR-2 MAST ↔ D-SPIN gene-level bridge",
  "",
  if (nrow(hits_bridge)) {
    c(
      "**First gene-level agreements between D-SPIN programs and the MAST catalogue:**",
      "",
      paste(capture.output(print(hits_bridge)), collapse = "\n")
    )
  } else {
    "- No MAST-catalogue gene (`Hap1`, `Cntn6`, `Itpkb`, `Eps8l1`, or other AMY hits) falls inside the three program gene sets."
  },
  "",
  "Full presence/absence table: `tables/VR2_mast_bridge.csv`.",
  ""
)
write_md(bridge_md, lines)
write_csv(bridge2, file.path(tbl_dir, "VR2_mast_bridge.csv"))
```

```{r}
#| label: cell-fig-spatial
#| eval: !expr run_analysis
#| fig-show: hide

# Panel coverage
panel_genes <- tryCatch({
  # from spatial prenorm — gene names via sparse matrix rownames if meta-only unavailable
  character(0)
}, error = function(e) character(0))

# MapMyCells labels for spatial cells
mmc <- read_csv(paths$mapmycells, show_col_types = FALSE, comment = "#")
# standardise
nm <- names(mmc)
id_col <- nm[1]
sup_col <- grep("supertype_name|SUPT", nm, value = TRUE, ignore.case = TRUE)[1]
if (is.na(sup_col)) {
  # columns from inventory peek
  # cell, class_label, class_name, ..., supertype_label, supertype_name, ...
  possible <- c("supertype_name", "CCN20230722_SUPT")
  sup_col <- intersect(possible, nm)[1]
}

meta_sp <- readRDS(paths$spatial_meta) %>% as_tibble(rownames = "cell_id")

# Join MapMyCells if cell ids align
if (!is.null(sup_col) && id_col %in% names(mmc)) {
  mmc2 <- mmc %>%
    rename(cell_id = !!id_col) %>%
    mutate(cell_id = as.character(cell_id))
  # find best name column
  name_col <- grep("supertype_name", names(mmc2), value = TRUE)[1]
  if (!is.na(name_col)) {
    gaba_cells <- mmc2 %>%
      filter(grepl("0338 |0355 |0359 |MEA-BST", .data[[name_col]])) %>%
      transmute(cell_id, supertype_name = .data[[name_col]])
  } else {
    gaba_cells <- tibble(cell_id = character(), supertype_name = character())
  }
} else {
  gaba_cells <- tibble(cell_id = character(), supertype_name = character())
}

plot_df <- meta_sp %>%
  mutate(cell_id = as.character(cell_id)) %>%
  left_join(gaba_cells, by = "cell_id") %>%
  mutate(is_gaba_supertype = !is.na(supertype_name))

# Crude anatomical compartments by Allen CCF if available
ccf2d <- file.path(paths$ccf_rebuild, "ccf2d.csv")
# Fallback: report fractions by roi / bregma only
frac <- plot_df %>%
  filter(is_gaba_supertype) %>%
  count(roi, bregma, name = "n") %>%
  group_by(roi) %>%
  mutate(frac = n / sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  mutate(
    compartment = "unassigned_pending_CCF_join",
    note = "Join Allen_CCF_rebuild labels within section before MeA/BST calls"
  )

# Panel coverage check using program genes vs spatial gene panel from prenorm object (lazy)
coverage_note <- sprintf(
  "Program-gene spatial panel coverage not fully quantified in this run (requires gene list from spatial object). Treat step 5 as qualitative until coverage ≥20%%."
)

write_csv(frac, spatial_frac)

p <- ggplot(plot_df %>% filter(is_gaba_supertype | row_number() %% 50 == 0),
            aes(center_x, center_y)) +
  geom_point(data = plot_df %>% slice_sample(n = min(20000, nrow(plot_df))),
             colour = "grey85", size = 0.1) +
  geom_point(data = plot_df %>% filter(is_gaba_supertype),
             aes(colour = supertype_name), size = 0.4) +
  coord_equal() +
  labs(title = "MeA–BST GABA-assigned cells on seqFISH sections",
       subtitle = coverage_note, colour = NULL) +
  vr_brand_ggplot() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")

ggsave(spatial_png, p, width = 10, height = 7, dpi = 200)

# Decision stub appended to overlap md
decision <- c(
  "",
  "## Spatial reference",
  "- Labels: MapMyCells Allen CCN20230722 hierarchy joined to seqFISH metadata by cell_id.",
  paste0("- ", coverage_note),
  "",
  "## Decision rule inputs",
  "- Compare Jaccard vs null, mean projection vs interneuron scores (with per-animal spread), and spatial MeA±BST fractions above.",
  ""
)
write_md(overlap_md, c(readLines(overlap_md, warn = FALSE), decision))
